description: Use the Subsurface Dive Planner to plan a recreational dive. Open the Dive Planner (from the Planner menu or toolbar). Set up a dive plan with the following parameters: Bottom depth: 30 meters; Bottom time: 40 minutes; Gas: Air (21% O2, 0% He); Surface Air Consumption (SAC): 20 liters/min. After entering the parameters and viewing the dive plan results, save the planned dive to your logbook by clicking 'Remember dive plan'.
